items.exampleEn: The test was hard. Nevertheless, she passed it.
items.exampleZh: 考試很難，不過她還是通過了。

items.exampleEn: I looked everywhere, but my keys were nowhere to be found.
items.exampleZh: 我到處都找過了，但哪裡都找不到鑰匙。

items.exampleEn: The shop is a mere five minutes from here.
items.exampleZh: 那間店離這裡只有五分鐘路程。

items.exampleEn: The room is clean. Furthermore, it has a nice view.
items.exampleZh: 這個房間很乾淨，此外景色也很好。

items.exampleEn: It was a long trip. Nonetheless, we enjoyed it.
items.exampleZh: 那趟旅程很長，不過我們還是玩得很開心。

items.exampleEn: My dog follows me wherever I go.
items.exampleZh: 不管我去哪裡，我的狗都跟著我。

items.exampleEn: The meal cost forty dollars altogether.
You can borrow my car, provided you drive carefully.
items.exampleZh: 只要你小心開車，就可以借我的車。

items.sentenceEn: The concert tickets cost sixty dollars altogether.
items.sentenceZh: 演唱會的票總共六十美元。

items.audioEn: The weather was bad. Nevertheless, Daniel went running in the park.
items.audioZh: 天氣很差，不過 Daniel 還是去公園跑步了。
items.questionZh: 天氣不好時，Daniel 做了什麼？

items.sentenceEn: You can sit wherever you like.
We will go to the beach provided it does not rain.
items.sentenceZh: 只要不下雨，我們就去海邊。

items.stemEn: The bus was late, and there was ____ to sit at the station.
items.stemZh: 公車誤點了，車站裡也找不到地方坐。

items.stemEn: This phone is light and fast. ____, the battery lasts two days.
items.stemZh: 這支手機又輕又快，此外，電池可以撐兩天。

items.passageEn: Daniel wanted to buy a used bike. He found one online for a mere fifty dollars. The owner said Daniel could have it, provided he picked it up that day. The shop was far away, and the bus ride took over an hour. Nevertheless, Daniel went there. The trip took two hours altogether. The bike was in very good condition. Furthermore, the owner gave him a free lock, so Daniel was very happy.
items.passageZh: Daniel 想買一台二手腳踏車。他在網路上找到一台，只要五十美元。店主說只要 Daniel 當天來拿，就可以賣給他。那間店很遠，搭公車要一個多小時。儘管如此，Daniel 還是去了。這趟路總共花了兩個小時。腳踏車的狀況非常好。此外，店主還送他一個免費的鎖，所以 Daniel 非常開心。

items.promptZh: 只要你準時完成，你今天就可以早點下班。
referenceEn: You can leave work early today, provided you finish on time.
Provided you finish on time, you can leave work early today.
rubricZh: provided 表示「只要」，引導條件
條件部分用現在式（例如 finish、complete）
「早點下班」可寫 leave work early、get off work early 等

items.instructionZh: 用 nevertheless 造兩個句子，說一件不順利但你仍然做到的事。
referenceEn: I was very tired. Nevertheless, I finished my homework.
The road was busy. Nevertheless, we arrived on time.
rubricZh: 前一句是不利的情況，後一句是儘管如此仍然發生的事
通常放在第二句句首，後面加逗號
